question: In October 2024, who has been appointed as the Chief of the Indian Coast Guard?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paramesh Sivamani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Paramesh Sivamani** was appointed as the **Chief of the Indian Coast Guard** in **October 2024**.
 
• The **Indian Coast Guard** is one of the country's critical maritime security agencies responsible for safeguarding India's vast coastline and enforcing maritime laws.
 
• **Paramesh Sivamani** is a highly experienced officer who has held various important positions within the Indian Coast Guard prior to his appointment as Chief.
 
• As Chief, he is tasked with overseeing operations such as **search and rescue missions**, **anti-smuggling operations**, and **maritime environmental protection**.
 
• The appointment of **Paramesh Sivamani** reflects the government's focus on ensuring robust maritime security and efficient management of India's coastal regions.
